description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EntityNotFoundException' used within the finance application's exception handling system. It extends a more general exception class 'SimpleBankingGlobalException' and provides constructors to instantiate the exception with a default message or a custom message, both referencing a specific global error code.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a requested entity was not found in the database.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message and error code.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message while using a predefined error code.
